summary: This directory is dedicated to the testing and validation of AI models. It focuses on ensuring that the models implemented within the application behave as expected through automated test suites.
responsibilities: Verify the correct behavior of AI model implementations
Validate model outputs and processing logic
Ensure stability of AI model integrations through testing
relationships: Test suites define the expected behavior for AI models.
Verification processes execute tests to validate AI model integrity.
designDecisions: Isolation of model tests into a dedicated directory
Standardization of validation routines for model components
